title: Art. 9.27 — Annex 9 - Facilitation, Chapter 9 - Passenger Data Exchange Systems, D. Passenger Name Record (PNR), 9.27
content: Recommended Practice. Subject to necessary and proportionate restrictions, Contracting States should notify individuals of the processing of their PNR data and inform them about the rights and means of redress afforded to them, as defined in their legal and administrative framework.
